codeSamples.code:
<?php

$baseUrl = 'https://api.spryng.nl/v2/schedules/delayed';
$ch = curl_init();

$baseUrl =  $baseUrl . '?DispatchName=String&StartCreatedDateTime=String&EndCreatedDateTime=String&StartSendDateTime=String&EndSendDateTime=String&StatusFilter=Array&Msisdns=Array&Channel=String&OrderBy=String&OrderDir=String&PageNumber=Integer&PageSize=Integer';

curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_URL, $baseUrl);

$headers = [
     'AccountReference' => 'your-AccountReference-header-here',
     'X-Api-Key' => 'YOUR_KEY_HERE'
    ];

curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, $headers);


curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);

$response = curl_exec($ch);
$info = curl_getinfo($ch);

curl_close($ch);

if ($info['http_code'] >= 400) {
    echo 'Error! HTTP code: ' . $info['http_code'] . ', Response: ' . $response;
} else {
    echo 'Success! Response: ' . $response;
}
?>

sections.title: API overview
sections.content: This endpoint allows you to retrieve all message schedule data and scheduleIds. If you would like to retrieve the schedule data for a specific message schedule, please use GET v2/schedules/delayed/{scheduleId}

sections.title: Headers
sections.content:
These parameters are mandatory to be provided in the header of your request. If not provided, or incorrect, your request will fail.

HeaderTypeDescription
X-Api-KeyStringAPI Key value for authorization
AccountReferenceStringYour Spryng account reference - e.g. SPNL0000000

Example request header:
GET https://api.spryng.nl/v2/schedules/delayed
-H 'Api-Key: YOUR_API_KEY'
-H 'AccountReference: SPNL0000000'

Optional input path parameters

The below parameters are optional within the path, they are designed to provide you further capability to filter your requests.

ParameterTypeDescription
DispatchNameQueryFilter by name
StartCreatedDateTimeStringFilter by created date/ time of the scheduled message. The time the message should be sent provided in ICT format YYYY-MM-DD:HH:MMZ e.g. 2025-03-05T11:47:25.723Z
StartSendDateTimeStringFilter by scheduled start send date/ time of the scheduled message. The time the message should be sent provided in ICT format YYYY-MM-DD:HH:MMZ e.g. 2025-03-05T11:47:25.723Z
EndSendDateTimeStringSort groups. Filter by scheduled end send date/ time of the scheduled message. The time the message should be sent provided in ICT format format YYYY-MM-DD:HH:MMZ e.g. 2025-03-05T11:47:25.723Z
StatusFilterArrayFilter by the status of the scheduled send. POssible values: Success | Scheduled | Canceled | Failed | Pending
MsisdnsArrayFilter by the recipients of the message
OrderByStringOrder the results by Asending or Desending
